splitOff.why: It relabels the first row of the address view page's summary list, built in the INS frontend's address-book view folder and its copy, which theme address-book owns.
It adds the 'Address can be used for' row to the address view page, in the INS frontend's address-book view, view-model and copy folders, which theme address-book owns.
It adds an inset to the address view page when it is opened with a return outside the address book, in the INS frontend's address-book view folder and copy, which theme address-book owns.
It adds an inset to the delete address page, in the INS frontend's address-book delete folder and copy, which theme address-book owns.
